data.exact_reserve_text: The result includes $88.9m of prior year reserve releases (7.1% on the combined ratio) and, adjusted for the loss portfolio reinsurance, improved the combined ratio by 5.8% (2020: 3.5%). The total prior year release also includes a release of $28.7m in relation to this contract.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Entered a loss portfolio reinsurance contract ceding predominantly legacy years; contributed to a release included within prior year reserve releases (release of $28.7m related to the contract).

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Insurance Company S.A. (LIC)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of European liabilities to LIC (effective 30 December 2020) and 100% quota share reinsurance back to the syndicate; described as having no economic impact on the Syndicate's accounts but affected presentation and settlement arrangements.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a prior year reserve release of $88.9m for calendar 2021, driven by favourable claims development and the effect of a loss portfolio reinsurance arrangement (which accounted for a $28.7m element of the release). The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was $4,727.8m and the net prior year release represents a modest improvement relative to that opening reserve position.
raw_causal_phrases: release of $28.7m in relation to this contract
profit on the loss portfolio reinsurance contract to RiverStone of $24.7m

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are denominated in USD (report currency). Prior year development amount (-88.9) was taken from the Directors' narrative which explicitly states "$88.9m of prior year reserve releases"; the report does not present a clearly labelled separate gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table in the extracted text, and parts of the gross claims development triangle in the PDF text extraction are fragmented. The loss portfolio reinsurance (RiverStone) and the Part VII transfer to LIC may distort development comparisons and the claims triangle; therefore the prior year movement is taken from the explicit narrative statement rather than attempting a full triangle-diagonal calculation.
